title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
summary: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.
author: Julie Bort

title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
summary: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
summary: The former Google CEO owns about 1% stake in the leading AI lab, Bloomberg reported.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
summary: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
summary: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Figma co-founder Dylan Field thinks MCP is not a perfect protocol
summary: Figma said it plans to support as many standards as possible without exposing all of its data.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
summary: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
author: Kate Park

title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
summary: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking a wide range of objects up, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant
summary: Yelp is embedding numerous new AI features into its app that can do everything from call to check on restaurant wait times to create personalized recommendations that remember your preferences.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
summary: Meeting note-taking tool Otter.ai announced on Tuesday that it has raised $320 million from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund (CVF), which provides capital to startups without diluting equity and gets returns on the results of marketing spend. Otter.ai said that it will use these funds fo
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
summary: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
summary: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
author: Julie Bort

title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
author: Julie Bort

title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
author: Aditya Mehta

title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
summary: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.
author: Marina Temkin

title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
summary: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
author: Sarah Perez
